dom.purpose: Accessible responsive HTML/CSS and design direction

motion.purpose: DOM timelines, reversible scroll and UI transitions

spatial.purpose: Three.js, R3F/Drei, glTF, shaders and optional bloom

assets.purpose: Original images, media and Blender/glTF handoff

textures.purpose: KTX2 production with local Three-compatible Basis decoders

review.purpose: Functional, visual, accessibility and GPU validation

optionalInputs.figma: Selected design files through the installed Figma skills; authentication is not file-authoring acceptance.
optionalInputs.imagegen: Built-in raster generation through the installed imagegen skill when original bitmap assets are selected.
optionalInputs.higgsfield: Image/video/3D model discovery and selected asset generation through the installed Higgsfield skill; preserve provenance and explicit paid-job authorization.
optionalInputs.firecrawl: Public design/reference/document research through the installed Firecrawl skill; inspection evidence remains owned by reference-reconstruction.
optionalInputs.babylon: Optional shader/geometry/particle/GUI/flow/render/filter graph authoring. Select a matching consumer runtime only when a project requires it.
